about.title: About Me
about.description:
I'm Navid Jaberi, a frontend engineer with more than 4 years of experience building production web applications, from SaaS platforms and internal tools to SEO-driven public sites. Most recently I worked full-time in a Scrum team at Dongi.

I learned frontend step by step along a structured roadmap, and I still work that way: I test what I ship and pick up new tools early. The clearest example is Vue Smart Loading Kit, my open-source library published on npm and checked with mutation testing. I also use AI tools like Claude Code, Codex and Copilot every day, with tests and types keeping their output in check.

My core stack is Vue 3 and Nuxt with TypeScript, Pinia and Tailwind CSS, and I also work with React and Next.js; this site is built with Next.js. I care about the parts users feel but rarely see: accessibility, Core Web Vitals, technical SEO, and RTL and multilingual interfaces.

I hold a bachelor's degree in psychology, which still shapes how I think about the people using what I build. I speak Persian (native), English (advanced) and Turkish (basic).

I'm looking for a team where I can take ownership of a product's frontend and keep growing.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: I'm open to new frontend roles. The quickest way to reach me is email, or you can message me on LinkedIn.
